name: Milieu
source:
One of the three siblings who serve Jean in the "Goddess Church".

His true identity is the origin of cloned humans. Gauche and Drowat are his clones.

He can't feel comfortable around Lily.

"This is really the last help."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
